decision.explanation: The term "Siraya" is supported as referring to both a language (from D1S2 and D3S3) and a type of ancient Taiwanese currency (from D2S4). These are distinct referents and do not conflict. The additional candidate answers either describe overlapping or related concepts (e.g., origin of the name "Taiwan") or refer to broader categories (e.g., "an Austronesian language family member") that are already covered by the accepted answers. There is no evidence to prefer one over the other or to exclude either.
